genomes.name: Calm Trend + Z-Dip Core
genomes.thesis: Three entries: above the 50-day mean while 20-day volatility is under 25%, a 1.35-sigma dip below the 20-day mean above the 200-day, a close back over the 50-day. Two exits: volatility over 50%, or a close under the 50-day that is not oversold. 4.2% stop, 7% target, 5.1% trailing stop, 13 sessions, two-session wait.
genomes.rationale: Written by Claude in round three: the trend-plus-dip leader reduced to its core; scored exactly as written.
